caption: The drawing depicts two views of a fork rendered in grayscale pencil or ink on an off-white or light beige background. The main object is a large, detailed fork positioned diagonally from the lower right to the upper left of the composition, showing its front side. The fork has four long tines and an ornate handle with decorative patterns near the end. To the right and slightly above the main fork, there is a smaller depiction illustrating the back or reverse side of the same fork, again highlighting the intricate design on its handle. Both objects are outlined and shaded to give a three-dimensional appearance. The objects are placed within a lined rectangular border in the center of the paper, with the handwritten text "Actual Size" below the rectangle and an artist’s signature in the bottom right corner. The background outside the border is plain, and the edges of the paper show slight discoloration or aging.
title: Silver Fork (Rogers Silverware)
